name: Avoid Programs with High Fan-In (Easytrieve)
description:
Avoid Programs with High Fan-In (Fan-In > X). The Fan-In of an Artifact is the number of other Artifacts that are referencing it. When computing the Fan-In of an Artifact, multiple accesses to it from the same Artifact are counted as one access.
The threshold level is a parameter that can be changed at will.
For an Easytrieve Program, these Artifacts are the Procedures and Programs of the other Easytrieve Programs that call it with CALL or LINK, and the Artifacts of other technologies that have a direct link to it. A COBOL program that calls it does not count: the call reaches it through a COBOL program prototype, which is not an Artifact.
output:
Associated to each Easytrieve Program with violations, the Quality Rule provides:
- The Fan-In
rationale:
An Artifact referenced by many other Artifacts is costly to change: a change can impact all of them, and all of them have to be tested again.
Changeability and testability decline with increasing Fan-In.
reference: Standard suggestions based on CAST Quality Model
remediation: Review the design of the Program: split it into smaller Programs with a single responsibility each, so that each caller depends only on what it uses.
